selection: Each geometry chooses one fixed recipe by final validation output error; every geometry receives the same candidate schedules/rates and budget.
kernel_interpretation: mu_i/mu_max and target weights diagnose normalized plain GD. They are not an Adam rate prediction.
numerical_resolution: rho <= 1e-18 target energy is numerically unresolved, not an established capacity floor.

frozen_second_moment_metric.interpretation: Endpoint second-moment metric only; momentum and evolving preconditioners remain. Relative spectrum omits learning rate, including at cooled cosine endpoints.
